messages:
amy_pm: Quick sync — I sketched a lightweight rollout plan for the Priority Matrix feature. Goal is to support enterprise opt-ins + staged regional gating with a fast fallback to the low-cost model variant. Need ops + eng signoff on flags, canary size, and customer exemption flow. TL;DR at the bottom.

jc_engineer: E.g., we want a 1% global canary, then region ramps (EU/US/APAC). For Dedicated accounts we skip the global canary and do per-tenant opt-in. Ops: does that tradeoff sound feasible?

maria_sre: Feasible. Two notes: 1) add a hard kill-switch at infra layer (not just flag). 2) Metric gating should include 95p latency + error-rate + token-cost delta. If any breach, auto-fallback.

kevin_sales: Can we add a customer-exemption clause so a customer can opt into early traffic for revenue pilots? They may want priority routing.

amy_pm: Yes — proposal: add a tenant opt-in in the flag metadata and a managed-exception tag that surfaces in Console. Managed-exceptions have to go through AE + security signoff.

luca_design: UX note: console should show which fallback model will be used and expected cost delta. Also show last 24h performance vs baseline.

jc_engineer: Implementation sketch for flags (rough):
```
flags:
  priority_matrix_enabled: boolean
  rollout_phase: enum [canary, regional_ramp, global]
  tenant_overrides: list[tenant_id]
  fallback_policy: enum [route-to-small-model, degrade-features, reject]
  kill_switch: boolean (infra)
```

maria_sre: +1. For canary sizing: 1% global for 48h (synthetic + real), then: EU 5% -> 20%, US 5% -> 30%, APAC 3% -> 15% over a week. Keep synthetic shadow traffic 100% to validate outputs.

amy_pm: What about A/B evaluation? We need quality checks — not just latency/cost. I propose: 50/50 AB split during canary for a subset (text similarity + human eval on failure cases).

jc_engineer: We can wire in the existing eval harness and flag the prompt set. Will need ~10k requests/day to get decent metrics. Also plan for deterministic seeding so we compare same prompts.

maria_sre: Fallback actions (ordered):
1) Route to quantized small-model variant (same API contract)
2) Enable degraded-mode (strip optional signals that are expensive)
3) Reject with friendly error and degrade to cached response for repeat queries
All will be automated via the routing policy.

kevin_sales: For enterprise customers that want guaranteed availability, can we add a "priority-reserve" tag that pins them to Dedicated capacity? They'd accept higher cost.

amy_pm: Yes — label them as "priority-route"; routing policy will prefer Dedicated pool if tag present. Need contract + commit.

luca_design: Quick copy for console warnings: "Performance fallback active: requests are served by lower-cost model. Expect lower fidelity for some outputs. Contact support for priority routing."

ops_bot: deploy-bot: new flag config uploaded by amy_pm at 2024-11-02T09:12:00Z :eyes:

amy_pm: Ops, can you add a preflight job that runs the eval prompts against both models and fails if quality < threshold? Also include a smoke test for KMS access (we need to ensure tenant keys available on Private).

maria_sre: I'll add the preflight. Thresholds proposed: similarity >= 0.85, top-1 error < 1.5%. If fails -> block rollout and notify #incidents + #product.

jc_engineer: Also adding a gradual token budget cap per canary slice so cost spikes trigger automatic rollback. Config idea: per-slice budget burn rate and spike multiplier.

amy_pm: Ops + Eng action items: 
- jc_engineer: prototype flag matrix and routing policy (ETA 3d)
- maria_sre: add preflight eval + infra kill-switch (ETA 2d)
- luca_design: console copy + UX for fallback visibility (ETA 2d)
- kevin_sales: draft customer exemption flow + contract note (ETA 4d)
I'll coordinate shiproom once the preflight is green.

kevin_sales: Heads-up: two customers already requested early opt-in (Acme / Northwell). Need SLA note.

amy_pm: Noted — I'll add them to tenant_overrides for the pilot but will require signed addendum.

maria_sre: Minor ops detail: ensure rotational KMS keys do not break tenant pinning for Private. Add test to preflight: rotate-key -> smoke requests -> sanity check.

jc_engineer: For monitoring: add a combined dashboard with token-cost delta, 95p latency, synthetics pass-rate, and human-eval regression. Alert policy: any two signals fail -> run rollback.

amy_pm: TL;DR: 1% global canary (48h) + regional ramp plan, tenant opt-in for pilots, multi-step automated fallback (small-model -> degrade -> reject), infra kill-switch, preflight evals (similarity + error thresholds), and console visibility for fallback + customer exceptions. Actions assigned above. Anyone object or major concerns? :thinking_face:

luca_design: No objections. :+1:

maria_sre: No objections. Will start infra work.

jc_engineer: No blockers from eng side.

amy_pm: Great — I'll open the shiproom invite and add the preflight checklist to the PR. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
